\chapter{Figure and data provenance}\label{app:provenance}

Every figure and every table of numbers in the book, Part by Part, with what it shows and where it comes from. Each file
name is a link to that file in the public repository \url{https://github.com/hmahaffeyges/IAM-Validation}; a script link
opens at the lines that draw the figure. To redraw a figure, run its script from the repository root. Figures computed
in the script read no data file: their numbers are physical constants and the values stated in the chapter. Chain
figures read the Cobaya chains through \texttt{\_chains.py} (30\,\% burn-in, weighted statistics), and growth figures use
\texttt{\_cosmo.py}, which solves the linear growth equation for $\Lambda$CDM and for IAM from the same early amplitude.
